title: data/now.json
description: What I am listening to and reading, for the homepage's Now strip and literature.html's Reading Now. Written weekly by .github/scripts/refresh_now.py from Last.fm (recent tracks) and the Goodreads currently-reading RSS. A source that fails keeps its previous value.

track.description: The most recent Last.fm scrobble, or null when Last.fm has none and there was no previous one to keep.

url.description: The track's Last.fm page; the Now strip links to it, falling back to music.html when empty.

nowPlaying.description: True when Last.fm reported it as playing at fetch time. Only this makes the strip's equaliser bounce (.is-playing); with a weekly refresh it is almost always false.

reading.description: Books on the currently-reading shelf, at most three, in the feed's order. The Now strip shows the first and a count of the rest.

title.description: Title as the feed gives it, series in brackets.

link.description: My Goodreads review page for the book (review/show/<id>), with the feed's tracking parameters.

img.description: Cover thumbnail from Goodreads' image host, when the feed has one.

updated.description: Date of the refresh that wrote the file, YYYY-MM-DD.
